title: Tensor Engine project stack
content:
- Tensor Engine: Rust deep learning framework (PyO3 bindings)
- Stack: Rust, ndarray, OpenBLAS, PyO3, safetensors, tokenizers (feature-gated)
- Key deps: ndarray, num-traits, rayon, crossbeam, hound, rubato, tch (feature-gated)
- GPU: CUDA kernels exist (src/backend/cuda_kernels.rs), wgpu WGSL shaders, Metal (feature-gated)
- Windows: OpenBLAS blocked by #[cfg(not(target_os = "windows"))] in compat_blas.rs
